target: current original SGBM optical depth absolute error >0.15m
consumer: confidence only; excluded points unknown, no free-space certificate or memory erasure
validation: fresh E0 and E1 whole actual legally terminated sequences; both gates required
features: current RGB paired patch texture/NCC/residual, original disparity/depth local gradients, current native camera registered height and disparity sensitivity; sensor packet membership carries existing CAD mask
truth: labels/scoring only; no future input; no position/frame/time as fitted features

coverage_gate.input_epochs: all scheduled capture indices0,5,... through actual legal terminal; counts may differ
coverage_gate.legal_terminal: success/collision/timeout90; timeout ends90; raw audit/status/seal prerequisite

model: single ridge logistic, 12 features, train-only mean/std, scipy L-BFGS-B maxiter150, lambda0.01, threshold P(bad)<0.5
fit_sampling: per-epoch sorted packet every8th point, deterministic; no validation sampling for scoring
failure: reject frozen model, no threshold/feature/model rescue; next distinct mechanism needs evidence

fresh_data_qualification.legal_terminal_complete: success/collision/timeout actual capture to terminal, schedule every5 captures; no future window
fresh_data_qualification.heldout: fresh E0 and E1, both must qualify >=70% valid point labels and >=95% eligible epochs, at least1000 total valid labels
fresh_data_qualification.model_and_retention_gates: unchanged; one fit; no old V fit or selected threshold

effective_precedence: This fresh protocol supersedes original V/181 sequence qualification; same features/model/error and retention gates, fit cap1 unchanged.
